sources.note: Schurter 6130.5630 C14 inlet listing (opened via a search result): panel cutout 27.5 x 19.5 mm. Schurter C14 inlets use 6.3 x 0.8 mm blades for line and neutral (retail datasheet snippets). The shroud of the model is that 27.5 x 19.5 mm outline with the two lower corners cut.

IEC 60320 article (opened): C14 is the appliance inlet with pin contacts and an earth contact, polarised; pin spacing "14 (H) 4 (V)" mm (read as line-neutral 14 mm apart; the vertical 4 mm is the earth offset). The dimensions are in the standard sheets, which were not available. ESTIMATES: flange 31 x 23 x 1.5 mm, pocket depth 12 mm, wall 1.3 mm, back shell to 26 mm, chamfer 3 mm, blade length 10.5 mm, blade positions (L and N at y -2, earth at +2 mm).
